description_full:
[PAID INTERNSHIP] P&G Management Internship application is now open! ✨

Looking for an extraordinary experience where you’re trusted to lead? This opportunity is for you.

Kick-start your career at P&G through an internship where you can take ownership of a project, gain meaningful learning, and make an impact from Day 1.

Applications are now open for Sales, Brand, and Product Supply, with more functions opening soon!

Submit your application today at pgcareers.com, and stay tuned for more function openings!
